title: wolfSSL ALPN parsing out-of-bounds read
bug_class: TLS ALPN extension parsing out-of-bounds read
input_type: crafted ALPN protocol list or TLS handshake extension
notes: Candidate selected from wolfSSL official security vulnerability entry. Expected root cause: incomplete validation in ALPN protocol-list parsing when HAVE_ALPN / --enable-alpn is enabled.
crash_signal: AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow; READ of size 200; memcmp -> wolfSSL_select_next_proto src/ssl.c:22298
reproduction_summary: The PoC calls wolfSSL_select_next_proto with malformed length-prefixed protocol lists. Both server and client lists are 5-byte heap buffers, but their first length byte is set to 200. In v5.8.4-stable, wolfSSL_select_next_proto uses the attacker-controlled length in memcmp, causing an ASan heap-buffer-overflow read. In v5.9.0-stable and current, the malformed protocol lists are rejected or handled safely without sanitizer errors.
